cards.intro:
FILM ROOM · THE READ
TWO MOVES MAX
One read. Two moves. Never a third.
Move 1 · In-and-out: hips open? Rise.
Move 2 · Square? One hard dribble - into his hip, past.
cards.outro:
Separation isn't
distance.
It's the beat his weight
went one way -
and you went up.
Every frame is AI-generated video: Seedance 2.5, animated from one AI-generated opening frame (Seedream 4.5). No real footage.

seq.caption:
...his hips open.
His weight is going with the drive.

Snatch it back - and rise.
He guessed your speed wrong.

Same move. Hard dribble out,
snatch it back...

...his hips stay square.
No window - don't force the shot.

Move 2: one hard dribble by him.
The back foot explodes.

Not around him - into his hip.
Then past.

Two moves, either way.
The third is where possessions die.
